items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: The trumpet player was Almer Talbot.

ctx.x: Who else was with the Olympia? Do you remember the trumpet player?
The trumpet player was Almer Talbot. Oh yeah.
How did he play in the old days? I heard him late years with George Lewis a couple of times. How did he play and was he real good early or how did he sound when...
